summary: More than most people, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you reach, grow, and lift the room and you build things that last and carry real weight — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: More than most people, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you reach, grow, and lift the room and you build things that last and carry real weight — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Balancing risk against prudence; unmanaged, it reads as inconsistency.
gift: At your best: you reach, grow, and lift the room, and you build things that last and carry real weight.
shadow: The trap: you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver — or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
integration: Let growth and belief and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Balancing risk against prudence; unmanaged, it reads as inconsistency.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you reach, grow, and you build things that last work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
